title: Sydia — asisten pribadi & memori berbasis chat
description: Sydia is a chat-first personal productivity and memory assistant for Indonesian users (WhatsApp + web). Send natural-language messages, documents, images and voice notes; Sydia turns them into reminders, tasks, events, notes and searchable memory.
source: Repo DESIGN.md (Aurora Haze) + apps/frontend/src/styles/globals.css + authenticated app screenshots (automated crawl of localhost:3000 was blocked, HTTP 403)
